drednicolson_asymmetric_tunic_and_sash.author: DredNicolson
drednicolson_asymmetric_tunic_and_sash.description: A sleeveless woman's tunic with asymmetric seams and hem with a sash around the hips. Fitted on the female base human. The diffuse texture is derived from GIMP's built-in Wildflowers pattern and one of my really old procedural textures where I was attempting to make wood and not succeeding makes pretty good stripes though . The normal and specular maps come from a desaturated fabric photo and an old pattern where I literally modelled thread with lots and lots of tiny cylinders. A grayscale bump map was baked first then I used that to bake normals. Most skirts/pants/underwear should fit underneath with no or minor clipping and there's enough mesh density in the chest area to fit most ahem cup sizes. Known Issues - Minor clipping or odd deformations occur in front of the armpits when the shoulders are rolled you can see it on the Benchmark or other extreme arm poses . For now it's easy enough to hot-fix in Blender until I figure out which helper verts are the guilty party. Plans - Add a tie for the sash. This might be better done as a separate accessory.

drednicolson_short-tail_camo_tee.author: DredNicolson
drednicolson_short-tail_camo_tee.description: A casual shirt with the tail not quite reaching the hips fully modeled seams and a camouflage pattern. Fitted on the female base human. Works okay for males too albeit with a 'shrunk in the wash' look. The camo was created with procedural textures multiplied down with a light AO map and then baked to an image. The specular map emphasizes self-shadowing in the seams. The normal map simulates individual stitches to produce a fabric-like sheen. The effect is more like satin than cotton but close enough. The chest area readily adapts to standard breast targets though minor clipping can occur with extreme combinations. Known Issues - A bit of ugly deformation in the armpits. Can be hot-fixed in Blender with Subsurf and Corrective Smooth modifiers.

elvs_disco_top2.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_disco_top2.description: A stylized draped draped silk scarf blouse for makehuman female models. Tri mesh. One texture setup included.

elvs_disco_top_1_butterfly.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_disco_top_1_butterfly.description: A stylized disco top for makehuman female models in a butterfly pattern. Tri mesh. One texture setup included. Due to butterfly arm shape the posing is not the best makehuman side on this one unfortunately.

elvs_ladies_tank1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_ladies_tank1.description: A tank top with narrow straps for female makehuman models utilizes delete groups on chest area distortion is minimal even on large chest sizes. One Camo texture included.

elvs_lara_tank1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_lara_tank1.description: Request Lara Croft Tomb raider 2001 movie edition costume pieces. A top for makehuman female models consisting of a tank top. Tri mesh. One texture setup included.

elvs_male_athletic_tank1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_athletic_tank1.description: A simple loose tank for makehuman male models.

elvs_male_logo_tshirt1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_logo_tshirt1.description: A model for makehuman male models consisting of a tshirt with various logo textures. One logo included with upload elvware several to follow in this tradition. This is a tri mesh but loads in Makehuman the same. Fan art textures for the community. Feel free to upload your own or hit me up with any ideas in pm. Shirt has armpit issues that persist in posing. Edited for use with trousers in overlapping by Punkduck ty.

elvs_male_muscle_shirt1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_muscle_shirt1.description: A shirt for makehuman male models with short sleeves and tight fitting. Quad based model and one simple texture included.

elvs_male_tankshirt1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_tankshirt1.description: A male shirt with tank style for makehuman models. Quad based model and one simple texture included.

elvs_ruffle_sleeve_peasant_blouse_1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_ruffle_sleeve_peasant_blouse_1.description: Loose fitting peasant blouse for female makehuman models.

mindfront_tank_top_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_tank_top_01.description: Tags: Casual Sport. If you use Blender Tip 1: After import tweak the clothing with the sculpt tool the clay and smooth brush with low strength to get rid of eventually ugly deformation and make the final fitness. Tip 2: Use the Solidify modifier thickness 1mm fill Only Rim to give the fabric some thickness. As usual I have not made any effort in the material settings.

punkduck_high_neck_crop_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_high_neck_crop_top.description: A sleeveless high neck crop top created by request. Delete groups are used and a normal map is supplied. An additional white texture is also available in the materials. A leggings costume leggings using the same pattern is also available.

punkduck_retro_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_retro_top.description: This is a typical 50s top. In reality it is convertible from a square neckline to a off shoulder neckline. It should be combined with the retro polka dot skirt. Normal map is added to create the pleats of the sleeves. The normal map is made visible by using the leather litsphere. In Blender the litsphere does not matter. Delete groups are used.

punkduck_sleeveless_crop_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_sleeveless_crop_top.description: This crop top should fit to most of the dresses. This 'initial' version is colored white like most of the t-shirts you can buy so it could be simply changed to a new color or pattern. Delete groups are use. You should connect the input of the glossy shader to the output of the image texture.

punkduck_sleeveless_shirt.author: punkduck
punkduck_sleeveless_shirt.description: The sleeveless shirt should be used for female characters. You may combine it with the jeans or minirock. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always. I added a picture in the forum tutorials/coloring white texture... how you change the material in Blender cycles to display every color you want and also how to change the details. The shirt uses the delete-group. All 5 buttons of the shirt resize geometrically Scale down the 4th button when you use bigger cup-sizes in Blender. Select all buttons in Blender and attach a new more shiny material e.g. put a math-node 0.5 clamp between fresnel and mix-shader .

punkduck_spaghetti_strap_tank_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_spaghetti_strap_tank_top.description: This tank top is designed for the jeans skirt. Maybe you have to make some corrections in Blender because I tried to let it not appear too bulky. When you combine it with the short jeans or tight jeans there IS additional work to do in Blender. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always. I added a picture in the forum tutorials/coloring white texture... how you change the material in Blender cycles to display every color you want. The shirt uses the delete-group.

punkduck_tube_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_tube_top.description: The tube top should work for most female characters. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always. I only add a white diffuse texture. I added a picture in the forum tutorials/coloring white texture... how you change the material in Blender cycles to display every color you want and also how to change the details. The tube top uses the delete-group.

punkduck_v_neck_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_v_neck_top.description: This v-neck t-shirt is designed to fit to the tight jeans and short jeans for females. For all of my three models this works fine but it could be that you have to change faces for your models. The v-neck top uses the delete-group. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always. I only add a white diffuse texture. I added a picture in the forum tutorials/coloring white texture... how you change the material in Blender cycles to display every color you want and also how to change the details.
